answer: Proof of stake serves as a defensive horizon for AI economies, mandating that agents lock capital to validate transactions. Much like shifting sand in a dune, an attacker must acquire massive economic assets to gain influence, rendering the identity a mere relic of past effort. The cost of a Sybil attack becomes prohibitively expensive, as the adversary must risk substantial collateral to compromise the network integrity, ensuring that voting power remains tied to verifiable financial stake.
